newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's APV seeks bids for Ozdi steel mill.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's APV seeks bids for Ozdi steel mill.

text.p: The Hungarian privatisation agency APV Rt is seeking to sell a 90 percent stake in the eastern Hungarian steel mill Ozdi Acelmuvek Kft through an open tender, APV said in a press release on Wednesday.
A 10 percent stake in the company will be set aside for Ozdi staff, it added.
Bids will be judged on the basis of the price offered, the bidder's commitment to obtain new markets for Ozdi's products and guarantees that staff reductions would be minimised, the statement said.
Ozdi manufactured 165,000 tonnes of steel and steel products in 1995, exporting over 15,000 tonnes.
It had sales of 5.3 billion forints in 1995 and after-tax profits of 20 million after taking 200 million in subsidies into account. (( -- Budapest newsroom (36 1) 327 40 40 ))
